name: Pufferfish [fugu; fuku]
definition: Raw pufferfish (Takifugu and relatives), sold whole or dressed with toxic organs removed, or as sashimi cuts; live fish are OUT (K-26).
notes: GI register: toxin-removed (polished) torafugu sold via wholesalers; sashimi not shown

name: Sea trout or brown trout [sewin]
definition: Raw trout Salmo trutta, sea-run (sea trout, sewin) or river-resident (brown trout), sold whole or as fillets; rainbow trout is J2.1.1.06.
notes: Rockfish lists wild sea trout whole and wild brown trout fillet; both pages show sold out

name: Whitefish [vendace; pollan; muikku]
definition: Raw whitefish of the genus Coregonus (vendace, pollan, lake whitefish), sold whole or as fillets; tinned whitefish is J2.4.28.
notes: Kespro lists frozen farmed Coregonus lavaretus fillet, 5 kg wholesale case; vendace not shown

name: Whitebait [shirasu]
definition: Juvenile small fish (anchovy, sardine, sprat, herring or galaxiid fry) sold whole, raw or plain boiled; uncoated only, semi-dried fry is J2.3.
notes: Frozen raw whitebait 1 kg (sold out) and frozen raw shirasu 200 g at Tagonoura coop shop

name: Cutlassfish [hairtail; tachiuo; galchi]
definition: Raw cutlassfish or hairtail (Trichiurus), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Frozen Jeju cutlassfish/hairtail 380 g pack; listing ingredient line oddly reads cuttlefish

name: Dried rockfish [geonureok]
definition: Rockfish (Sebastes) salted and dried or half-dried, sold whole to grill or steam; raw rockfish is J2.1.1.47.
notes: Korean GI register entry: dried rockfish (건우럭) Shinan; no shop page found; catalogue entry only

name: Vinegar-marinated sea bream [sasazuke]
definition: Small sea bream fillets salted, then marinated in vinegar and sold chilled in a tub or tray; Wakasa Obama kodai sasazuke is a named form (JC1).
notes: GI register: kodai fillets lightly salted, vinegar-pickled, barrel-packed; sale page not found

name: Vendace roe [löjrom]
definition: Roe of the vendace Coregonus albula, small orange eggs sold lightly salted, chilled or frozen.
notes: Kalix löjrom jar shipped frozen; Vänerlöjrom salted roe about 2000 SEK/kg
